name: sdd
description: Spec-Driven Development pipeline: 21 atomic Socratic skills (survey → spec → design → data-model → api → tasks → tests → implement → review → ship) + a living Now/Next/Later roadmap above the per-feature flow, plus a TDD implementation engine. Depth-tunable Q&A (easy/medium/hard), surface-aware design (backend/web/mobile/desktop/CLI/worker/library as C4 containers), every acceptance criterion covered end-to-end, and a copy-ready handoff block at every stage. Skills are the open Agent Skills format (SKILL.md); the Claude-specific mechanisms degrade per skills/_shared/tool-adapters.md. New: `orchestrate` runs the whole pipeline autonomously from a plain-language brief — every stage runs in its own stage-runner agent while the orchestrator (the strongest model) answers every question, runs every sub-agent, and records each decision with its grounding in a ledger. `visual-test` closes the pipeline: a visual-tester agent runs the app with computer use / a real browser, tests every UI acceptance criterion and screen at laptop + phone sizes with screenshots, and every Fix-now finding goes to `fix` (under the orchestrator: one fix agent per finding, then a re-test).
